pack.description: Slug. Also the file name: packs/<pack>.yaml

readiness_bar.description: The bar this field's readiness is held to unless its farmer sets another: 1 to 100, as a farmer may set.

perennial.description: true for goals with no end (a language, a habit). Readiness is not shown.

energy_cap.description: The most of each day's energy this field may use, in percent. The Workshop uses 30.

finds.description: Wild finds: short facts foraged in the wilderness next to what is growing. Add nothing to readiness.

near.description: Seeds in this pack the find grows next to.

seed.description: Optional: a wild seed in this pack that this find can be domesticated into.

id.description: Unique across all packs. Never rename or remove a released seed.

branch.description: Must match a branch id in this pack.

tier.description: Depth in the learning tree. 0 = needs nothing rooted first. Layer balance may still make a seed in a high layer wait.

needs.description: Seed ids that must be rooted first. Same pack only, for now.

wild.description: Hidden until foraged and domesticated. Needs a find that points at it.

sapling_of.description: A seed of this pack that drops this one when it is harvested. A sapling is hidden until then, and like a wild seed it is an extra: it never counts towards readiness. Never add this to a released seed, and never change it.

edge.description: The pack id of a second field this seed borders. Its harvest pays double once a tree is rooted in that field. May be added to a released seed, never removed or changed.

earned.description: Learning that has to happen before this seed can be planted: seeds rooted, or a field's readiness. One or the other.

pack.description: Another pack. Needed for `readiness`. For `rooted`, leave it out to count every other field.

rooted.description: This many seeds rooted, in `pack` or in any other field.

readiness.description: `pack`'s readiness at this number or over.

minutes.description: Time to plant: read the source, write notes.

summary.description: What to read and what the yield of planting is.

rubric.description: Lines an explanation is rated against: the explain rung of the depth ladder, and judged harvests.

prompts.description: For judged/solve/artifact harvests: open prompts, one is picked at harvest time.

why.description: Shown after answering. Teach, do not just confirm.

source.description: Source id or a short citation.
